entries.title: Psalms 148:1
segments:
. The scope of this Psalm is the same as that of the preceding. 
 
    1. heavens [and] heights--are synonymous.

segments:

    he commanded--"He" is emphatic, ascribing creation to God alone.

entries.title: Psalms 148:7
segments: 7-10. The call on the earth, as opposed to heaven, includes seas or depths, whose inhabitants the dragon, as one of the largest (on leviathan, see on
), is selected to represent. The most destructive and ungovernable agents of inanimate nature are introduced

entries.title: Psalms 148:8
segments: 8. fulfilling his word--or, law, may be understood of each. Next the most distinguished productions of the vegetable world.

entries.title: Psalms 148:9
segments: 9. fruitful trees--or, "trees of fruit," as opposed to forest trees. Wild and domestic, large and small animals are comprehended.

entries.title: Psalms 148:11
